set -eu
work_file=/tmp/supervisor.py.repaired
cat > "$work_file" <<'PY_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python
import os
import sys
import time

base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
results_path = os.path.join(base, "results.tsv")

if len(sys.argv) != 2:
    sys.stderr.write("usage: %s JOB_COUNT\n" % sys.argv[0])
    sys.exit(2)

try:
    job_count = int(sys.argv[1])
except ValueError:
    sys.stderr.write("JOB_COUNT must be a non-negative integer\n")
    sys.exit(2)

if job_count < 0:
    sys.stderr.write("JOB_COUNT must be a non-negative integer\n")
    sys.exit(2)

children = {}
for number in range(job_count):
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        time.sleep(0.1)
        os._exit(0 if number % 2 == 0 else 3)
    children[pid] = number

statuses = {}
while children:
    pid, status = os.waitpid(-1, 0)
    number = children.pop(pid)
    if os.WIFEXITED(status):
        exit_status = os.WEXITSTATUS(status)
    elif os.WIFSIGNALED(status):
        exit_status = 128 + os.WTERMSIG(status)
    else:
        continue
    statuses[number] = exit_status

with open(results_path, "a") as results:
    for number in sorted(statuses):
        results.write("current\t%d\t%d\n" % (number, statuses[number]))
PY_EOF
/usr/bin/python -m py_compile "$work_file"
install -o root -g root -m 0755 "$work_file" /srv/legacy2/child-process-reaping/supervisor.py
restorecon /srv/legacy2/child-process-reaping/supervisor.py 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' 'installed repaired supervisor'
sed -n '1,240p' /srv/legacy2/child-process-reaping/supervisor.py

set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/child-process-reaping
./supervisor.py 6 &
supervisor_pid=$!
printf 'supervisor_pid=%s\n' "$supervisor_pid"
if kill -0 "$supervisor_pid" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'supervisor_alive_while_children_run=yes'; else echo 'supervisor_alive_while_children_run=no'; exit 1; fi
ps -o pid=,ppid=,state=,args= --ppid "$supervisor_pid" || true
wait "$supervisor_pid"
printf 'supervisor_exit=%s\n' "$?"
if ps -eo ppid=,state= | awk -v p="$supervisor_pid" '$1 == p { found=1 } END { exit found ? 0 : 1 }'; then echo 'unreaped_children=yes'; exit 1; else echo 'unreaped_children=no'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- results.tsv with visible delimiters ---'
sed -n l results.tsv
printf '%s\n' '--- semantic validation ---'
awk -F '\t' 'BEGIN { for (i=0; i<6; i++) expected[i]=(i%2)*3 } /^current\t/ { if (($2 in expected) && $3 == expected[$2]) { seen[$2]++ } } END { for (i=0; i<6; i++) if (seen[i] != 1) { print "bad_or_missing_job=" i; exit 1 }; print "all_6_job_statuses_correct=yes" }' results.tsv
grep -Fqx 'previous,0,0' results.tsv
echo 'previous_result_preserved=yes'
